scene_info.name: Gears · V1 / V2 / V3
scene_info.description: 有界局部几何细化，保留源部件运动；RGB、SSIM、LPIPS、邻域一致性与低阶连续时序外观优化。5个时刻留出验证及选点，非独立新视角测试。 已提供修正版，绑定真实源动画，未新增事件训练。 版本重新编号：V1=原V2，V2=原V1，V3不变；模型、测量值与原始来源不变，不代表新增训练或已验证逐层消融。

surface_refinement.method: Source-surface tangent Gaussians with robust material/planar-patch V3 appearance
surface_refinement.motion: Exact source rigid-part ownership; no temporal filtering
surface_refinement.limitation: Uses supplied Blender geometry as a prior; not new event training or independent reconstruction accuracy

appearance_refinement.selection: Minimum validation LPIPS, MSE within 5 percent of previous stage
appearance_refinement.changes: Bounded canonical geometry offsets and appearance parameters
appearance_refinement.scope: Single-view in-sequence RGB-supervised fit; held-out timestamps, not unseen-view or event-only training

geometry_refinement.representation: time-independent local Gaussian-frame offset; follows parent rigid motion

clay.description: 清晰柔光白模，抑制表面颗粒、增强部件层次；保留连续筋条、孔边与轮廓，淡线框可选。

pseudocolor.description: 靛蓝、湖青、柔金与珊瑚橙平滑渐变，柔和亮部与清晰部件层次；配色固定在表面、随动画运动，两侧统一配色。颜色为展示配色，不代表真实材质或误差。

version_presentation.disclosure: 版本重新编号：V1=原V2，V2=原V1，V3不变；模型、测量值与原始来源不变，不代表新增训练或已验证逐层消融。
version_presentation.changes: Labels and display/export ordering only; raw assets and measured values unchanged

alignment.method: Supplied pixel coordinates and timestamps, no synthesized events
alignment.limitation: Shared pixel/time convention; no independent calibration claim

model_state_policy: fixed sampled points and verified part transforms only; full models are external
